name: Colossus Hunters
summary:
**Four friends. One giant. Your own two hands.**

Cindergaunt is a walking volcano. He sleeps in his den at the edge of a burning wasteland, and you're going to wake him.

**An expedition, not an arena.** Head out from camp into open volcanic land. Light the signal fire on a crag, cool the lava spring, raid brood nests and reach rare finds high on the rocks with your hook and rope. Every task you finish makes the fight ahead easier.
